modellek.leiras: AI models run on this Mac. A model is downloaded only when you choose to, and nothing you write is sent anywhere.
modellek.hiba_javitas: Check that Manifold is running, then reload the list. If it keeps failing, open diagnostics.
modellek.ures_leiras: The model list of this installation is empty or could not be read. Reload it, or open diagnostics.
modellek.nincs_talalat_leiras: Clear the role and language filters to see every model.
modellek.kalibracio_hint: To measure a model on your own examples, use the calibration page.
modellek.ajanlott.nincs: No models are marked as recommended in this installation.
modellek.ajanlott.csak_kattintasra: Nothing is downloaded until you press the button. You can cancel a download at any time and resume it later.
modellek.jel.kalibralt_leiras: Measured on a set of known examples and passed the threshold for this task: its results are used for real.
modellek.jel.proba_leiras: Not calibrated for this task: its output is only a trial. It works on a trial copy, never directly on your notes.
modellek.allapot.nincs_leiras: This model is not on this Mac.
modellek.allapot.reszleges_leiras: A download was interrupted. Resume it to finish; files already downloaded are kept.
modellek.allapot.ellenorizetlen_leiras: The files are there, but they have not been checked against the expected version yet. Download again to verify them.
modellek.allapot.kesz_leiras: The model is complete and checked.
modellek.allapot.elter_revizio_leiras: A different version of this model is on disk. Manifold uses only the supported version: download it to use this model.
modellek.allapot.konvertalasra_var_leira: The files are downloaded, but the model needs a one-time local conversion before it can run.
modellek.letoltes.megszakitva: Download cancelled. Press Resume to continue where it stopped.
modellek.torles.foglalt: Finish or cancel the download or test first.
modellek.torles.kovetkezmeny: Its calibration marks are removed too. You can download it again at any time.
modellek.teszt.leiras: A test measures how well the model does one task on a set of known examples. It first runs a short trial on 3 items, then the full measurement, and then gives a result: Calibrated or Trial. It can take a long time; it pauses while you work, and you can stop it and continue later.
modellek.teszt.nincs_telepitve: Install the model first: only a complete, verified model can be tested.
modellek.teszt.halmaz_sajat_nincs: My own examples (approve a set under Calibration first)
modellek.teszt.kuszob_nincs: This task has no calibration threshold yet, so no model can be marked Calibrated for it.
modellek.teszt.masik_fut: Another model test is running. Wait for it to finish.
modellek.teszt.megszakitva: Test stopped. Start it again to continue where it stopped.
modellek.teszt.ok_ismeretlen: The model could not be marked as calibrated.
modellek.teszt.eredmeny_kalibralt: The model passed: it is calibrated for this task.
modellek.teszt.eredmeny_proba: The model is not calibrated for this task: its output stays marked Trial.
modellek.teszt.megallitva: The test was stopped before it finished. Start it again to continue.
modellek.kal.leiras: A model is Calibrated for a task only after it has been measured on a set of known examples and reached the threshold for that task. Everything else is a Trial.
modellek.kal.jel_leiras: Run “Test this model” on the Models page to measure a model. The thresholds below cannot be lowered.
modellek.kal.nincs_kuszob: No threshold yet: cannot be calibrated
modellek.kal.nincs_szallitott: No example sets are shipped with this installation.
modellek.halmaz.leiras: Measure a model on examples from your own work. Choose a file with your examples, review the items, approve the set, and then pick it when you test a model. Your examples stay on this Mac.
modellek.halmaz.nincs_tamogatott: Your own examples are not available for any task in this installation.
modellek.halmaz.allapot.nincs: No set of your own yet
modellek.halmaz.valasztott: Used for tests of this task
modellek.halmaz.fajl_cim: Step 1: choose a file with your examples
modellek.halmaz.mezok.kiegeszites: A list of examples. Each one has the text before the cursor (elotte), the text after it (utana) and a list of acceptable continuations (elfogadhato).
modellek.halmaz.mezok.kifejtes: A list of examples. Each one points to a note (ut), the start (kezd) and end (veg) of a selected passage, groups of key phrases an answer should contain (kulcs) and topic words (tema).
modellek.halmaz.mezok.osszefoglal_kijelo: A list of examples. Each one points to a note (ut), the start (kezd) and end (veg) of a selected passage and groups of key phrases a summary should contain (kulcs).
modellek.halmaz.hiba.olvashatatlan: The file could not be read as a list of examples.
modellek.halmaz.hiba.nincs_lista: The file does not contain a list of examples.
modellek.halmaz.atnezes: Step 2: keep the items you trust. Untick any you want to leave out.
modellek.halmaz.jovahagyva: The set is approved. Choose it to use it for tests.
modellek.halmaz.valasztva_sajat: Tests of this task now use your own examples.
modellek.halmaz.valasztva_szallitott: Tests of this task use the shipped examples again.
modellek.halmaz.torles_kovetkezmeny: The set is moved aside, not erased for good. Models measured on it keep their results, but they are no longer re-measured on it.
modellek.ai.mi.nincs_ai_runtime: The AI engine is not available.
modellek.ai.mi.worker_hiba: The AI model stopped with an error.
modellek.ai.teendo.nincs_kalibralt: Install a model for this task in Settings › AI › Models, then run “Test this model”. Only a calibrated model can be used.
modellek.ai.teendo.nincs_telepitve: Download a model for this task in Settings › AI › Models.
modellek.ai.teendo.csak_tavol: Try again when you are not working on this Mac, or choose a smaller model in Settings › AI › Models.
modellek.ai.teendo.nincs_ai_runtime: Open Health to see what is missing, or set up AI again from Settings › General.
modellek.ai.teendo.worker_hiba: Try again. If it keeps happening, open Health for details.

hiba.modell.tiltott_fajlnev: The model source contains an unsafe file name.
